en.h1: Samsung Washing Machine Leaking Water: Safe Checks
en.description: A Samsung washer can leak because of a hose or connection, trapped material at the door seal, excess detergent, incorrect drainage or an internal fault.
en.quick_fix: Stop the cycle, close the water taps and isolate power only if the plug and surrounding area are dry; do not use the washer until the leak source is resolved (about 5–30 minutes).
en.intro_html:
A Samsung washer can leak because of a hose or connection, trapped material at the door seal, excess detergent, incorrect drainage or an internal fault.

Stop the cycle, close the water taps and isolate power only if the plug and surrounding area are dry; do not use the washer until the leak source is resolved. Open no panels, make no electrical measurements and do not order a part from the symptom alone.

causes_json.cause: Debris or damage at the door seal
causes_json.detail: This is a possible cause; the exact model manual and professional diagnosis determine internal faults.

causes_json.cause: Excess detergent or incorrect drain installation
causes_json.detail: This is a possible cause; the exact model manual and professional diagnosis determine internal faults.

causes_json.cause: Internal hose, valve, tub or pump fault
causes_json.detail: This is a possible cause; the exact model manual and professional diagnosis determine internal faults.

steps_json.detail: Stop the programme and wait for the drum to stop. If water is near electricity, isolate power from a safe, dry location.
Photograph the display and visible symptoms and note the model number and programme stage.
Stop the cycle, close the water taps and isolate power only if the plug and surrounding area are dry; do not use the washer until the leak source is resolved. Always follow the exact model manual.
Test only after correcting an external cause, and never with leakage, burning smell, smoke, abnormal heat or electrical damage.
Request service if the problem remains or returns. Dismantle nothing and measure no internal parts.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
Arrange Samsung service when safe external checks do not resolve the problem. Locks, heaters, sensors, valves, pumps, suspension, wiring and electronics are not user repairs.

Stop immediately for water near electricity, burning smell, smoke, sparks, abnormal heat or tripped protection.

Follow installation, load and detergent instructions, keep visible hoses and seals clean, and make sure the washer is level.

Internal mechanical and electrical faults cannot be prevented through dismantling.

faq_json.answer: Stop the cycle, close the water taps and isolate power only if the plug and surrounding area are dry; do not use the washer until the leak source is resolved. Do not continue if the problem remains or there is water near electricity, burning smell, smoke or abnormal heat.

Kontrollera valt program och extern varmvattenförsörjning där det är relevant, dokumentera eventuell kod och boka service om uppvärmningen förblir onormal. Öppna inga paneler, gör inga elektriska mätningar och beställ inte reservdel från symtomet ensam.

causes_json.cause: Programmet använder begränsad eller ingen uppvärmning
causes_json.detail: Detta är en möjlig orsak; exakt modellmanual och professionell diagnos avgör interna fel.

causes_json.cause: Extern varmvattenförsörjning saknas på berörda modeller
causes_json.detail: Detta är en möjlig orsak; exakt modellmanual och professionell diagnos avgör interna fel.

causes_json.cause: Informationskod för temperatur
causes_json.detail: Detta är en möjlig orsak; exakt modellmanual och professionell diagnos avgör interna fel.

causes_json.cause: Internt fel i värmare, sensor, kablage eller styrning
causes_json.detail: Detta är en möjlig orsak; exakt modellmanual och professionell diagnos avgör interna fel.

steps_json.detail: Stoppa programmet och vänta tills trumman står stilla. Vid vatten nära el bryter du strömmen på säkert avstånd.
Fotografera display och synliga symptom och anteckna modellnummer och programfas.
Kontrollera valt program och extern varmvattenförsörjning där det är relevant, dokumentera eventuell kod och boka service om uppvärmningen förblir onormal. Följ alltid manualen för exakt modell.
Testa endast efter korrigerad yttre orsak och aldrig vid läckage, bränd lukt, rök, onormal värme eller elskada.
Boka service om problemet kvarstår eller återkommer. Demontera inget och mät inga interna delar.

sv.when_to_call_technician_html:
Boka Samsung-service om säkra yttre kontroller inte räcker. Lås, värmare, sensorer, ventiler, pumpar, upphängning, kablage och elektronik är inte användarreparationer.

Avbryt direkt vid vatten nära el, bränd lukt, rök, gnistor, onormal värme eller utlöst elskydd.
sv.prevention_html:
Följ installations-, last- och doseringsanvisningar, håll synliga slangar och tätningar rena och kontrollera att maskinen står plant.

Interna mekaniska och elektriska fel kan inte förebyggas genom demontering.

faq_json.question: Kan jag använda maskinen när den värmer inte vattnet?
faq_json.answer: Kontrollera valt program och extern varmvattenförsörjning där det är relevant, dokumentera eventuell kod och boka service om uppvärmningen förblir onormal. Fortsätt inte om problemet kvarstår eller om det finns vatten nära el, bränd lukt, rök eller onormal värme.

faq_json.question: Vilka kontroller är säkra för användaren?
faq_json.answer: Kontrollera endast synliga slangar, kranar, last, nivå, program och användaråtkomliga delar som exakt modellmanual beskriver.

faq_json.question: Ska jag tvinga luckan eller öppna en panel?
faq_json.answer: Nej. Tvinga aldrig luckan, flytta inte en vattenfylld maskin och ta inte bort några höljen.

faq_json.question: Visar symtomet vilken reservdel som behövs?
faq_json.answer: Nej. Samsung eller en kvalificerad tekniker måste diagnostisera interna komponenter före beställning.

faq_json.question: När krävs service?
faq_json.answer: Boka service om säkra yttre kontroller inte räcker eller om problemet återkommer.

en.title_tag: Samsung Washing Machine Vibrating: Safe Checks
en.meta_description: Samsung washer is vibrating excessively? Read safe external checks, important stop rules and when authorised service is required.
en.h1: Samsung Washing Machine Vibrating: Safe Checks
en.description: Samsung identifies an unstable or unlevel installation, shipping bolts and an unbalanced or unsuitable load as common causes of excessive vibration.
en.quick_fix: Stop the cycle, redistribute the load and verify that the washer stands firm and level; for a new front loader, confirm shipping-bolt removal using the installation manual (about 5–30 minutes).
en.intro_html:
Samsung identifies an unstable or unlevel installation, shipping bolts and an unbalanced or unsuitable load as common causes of excessive vibration.

Stop the cycle, redistribute the load and verify that the washer stands firm and level; for a new front loader, confirm shipping-bolt removal using the installation manual. Open no panels, make no electrical measurements and do not order a part from the symptom alone.

causes_json.cause: Unbalanced, single-heavy-item or overloaded load
causes_json.detail: This is a possible cause; the exact model manual and professional diagnosis determine internal faults.

causes_json.cause: Washer is not level on a solid floor
causes_json.detail: This is a possible cause; the exact model manual and professional diagnosis determine internal faults.

causes_json.cause: Shipping bolts remain on a front loader
causes_json.detail: This is a possible cause; the exact model manual and professional diagnosis determine internal faults.

causes_json.cause: Internal suspension, bearing or drive fault
causes_json.detail: This is a possible cause; the exact model manual and professional diagnosis determine internal faults.

steps_json.detail: Stop the programme and wait for the drum to stop. If water is near electricity, isolate power from a safe, dry location.
Photograph the display and visible symptoms and note the model number and programme stage.

Stop the cycle, redistribute the load and verify that the washer stands firm and level; for a new front loader, confirm shipping-bolt removal using the installation manual. Always follow the exact model manual.
Test only after correcting an external cause, and never with leakage, burning smell, smoke, abnormal heat or electrical damage.
Request service if the problem remains or returns. Dismantle nothing and measure no internal parts.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
Arrange Samsung service when safe external checks do not resolve the problem. Locks, heaters, sensors, valves, pumps, suspension, wiring and electronics are not user repairs.

Stop immediately for water near electricity, burning smell, smoke, sparks, abnormal heat or tripped protection.
en.prevention_html:
Follow installation, load and detergent instructions, keep visible hoses and seals clean, and make sure the washer is level.

Internal mechanical and electrical faults cannot be prevented through dismantling.

faq_json.question: Can I use the washer when it is vibrating excessively?
faq_json.answer: Stop the cycle, redistribute the load and verify that the washer stands firm and level; for a new front loader, confirm shipping-bolt removal using the installation manual. Do not continue if the problem remains or there is water near electricity, burning smell, smoke or abnormal heat.

faq_json.question: Which checks are safe for the user?
faq_json.answer: Check only visible hoses, taps, load, level, programme and user-accessible items described by the exact model manual.

faq_json.question: Should I force the door or open a panel?
faq_json.answer: No. Never force the door, move a water-filled washer or remove any enclosure.

faq_json.question: Does the symptom identify a replacement part?
faq_json.answer: No. Samsung or a qualified technician must diagnose internal components before ordering.

faq_json.question: When is service required?
faq_json.answer: Arrange service when safe external checks do not resolve the problem or it returns.
